task: Add in-app self-update to CodeMie Desktop by integrating tauri-plugin-updater with a once-per-day throttle, app-version banner distinct from the existing CLI-update banner, and offline/blocked-download error surfacing.

key_reasoning.reason: Spans new Rust commands/updater.rs module, frontend boot flow and banner state (renderer.js, index.html), bridge module (runner-bridge.js), four config surfaces (Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, capabilities/default.json, CSP), plus a new external integration point for the update manifest endpoint — 4+ components across entirely new subsystem abstraction; bumped XL→XXL by 'integration with new external service' red flag.

No tauri-plugin-updater precedent exists in this repo; binary replacement/restart is novel; existing failure-handling collapses all errors to empty string with no precedent for distinguishable offline vs blocked surfacing; ACs enumerate offline/blocked, daily throttle, and restart-preserving-state edge cases with zero existing test template coverage; CSP must be explicitly widened for the manifest/artifact host — two auto-bumps (security surface gap + edge-case AC with no test template) advance base XL to XXL.

UI (renderer.js, index.html), API (Tauri IPC command registration), Service (updater.rs logic, daily throttle persistence), Infrastructure (tauri.conf.json plugin block, capabilities/default.json permission, CSP connect-src), External (update manifest/artifact endpoint via tauri-plugin-updater) — full stack plus External; bumped XL→XXL by 'integration with new external service' red flag.

Core requirements are defined but 2 of 7 ACs explicitly depend on an unshipped 'app-managed install' branch in the CLI team's bundled package (confirmed absent in the staged 0.14.1 tree); throttle persistence mechanism, CSP/endpoint host, and banner visual spec are open design decisions; 'installed agents' AC depends on an unimplemented placeholder view (#agents-view) in the same codebase.

Estimated 11 modified files (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, tauri.conf.json, tauri.windows.conf.json, capabilities/default.json, lib.rs, state.rs, renderer.js, index.html, runner-bridge.js, version-utils.test.mjs) plus 2 new files (commands/updater.rs, updater.test.mjs) across 5 directories — falls in XL range.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped XL→XXL: integration with new external service (update manifest/artifact endpoint added via tauri-plugin-updater).
Affected Layers bumped XL→XXL: integration with new external service adds External layer on top of the full UI+API+Service+Infrastructure stack.

Technical Risk auto-bump (security surface): binary update mechanism with CSP expansion and signed-artifact handling has no existing reusable template in this repo covering that injection/execution surface.

Technical Risk auto-bump (edge-case ACs): acceptance criteria enumerate offline/blocked download, once-per-day throttle, and restart-preserving-state cases; no existing test template covers any of these defensive patterns (all current failure-handling collapses to empty string; no throttle or restart test exists).

split_recommendation.ordering_note: Rust backend must ship first — the frontend bridge and banner depend on the new IPC commands being registered and the plugin capability being in place.

slices.title: Backend: tauri-plugin-updater integration, updater command module, daily throttle, error surfacing
slices.scope: Add tauri-plugin-updater to Cargo.toml; wire the updater:default capability and CSP connect-src; implement commands/updater.rs with check-for-update, download-and-install, and throttle-timestamp logic; add CmdResult error variants that distinguish offline from blocked; register all commands in lib.rs; add Rust unit tests for throttle guards and error-path variants.

slices.title: Frontend: app-version update banner, boot-flow integration, bridge functions, frontend tests
slices.scope: Add app-scoped update state (distinct from cliVersionState) to renderer.js; add an app-update banner section to index.html that is visually distinguishable from the CLI banner; extend runner-bridge.js updater exports with the new backend commands; integrate the daily update check into boot(); persist the throttle timestamp via localStorage; surface offline/blocked errors in the banner; add node:test cases for throttle logic and banner state transitions.
slices.depends_on: Backend: tauri-plugin-updater integration, updater command module, daily throttle, error surfacing
